issues: The subject was a generic grey placeholder dashboard; before and after differed only by a grey wash, so nothing showed what was processed
The whole frame was flat light grey with no light, stage, colour or focal point
Labels were tiny 20px pills and the divider/handle looked like a wireframe
The fling-then-scrub rhythm existed but there was no content to prove what changed, so the slow scrub read as nothing
changes: Graphite dark stage so the photo is the only colour in frame; header shows the fictional imaging product Kaleo Enhance with a Super Resolution 4× badge

The subject is now a 1400×788 procedural dusk lake photo (four ridge layers with rim light, setting sun, stars, reflection glitter, pine silhouettes) whose fine detail is exactly what the before loses
Before is a believable low-quality original: 12px mosaic via an SVG pixelate filter, half saturation, low contrast and high-ISO colour noise; after is the clean image, same layout and framing
Retimed to 165f: bar draws in, 6f anticipation, 12f expo-out fling to 78%, 14f settle to 70%, 20f hold, 54f slow scrub to 40%, 43f hold, with a 2.5% slow push throughout

2px glowing white divider and an 84px knob that stretches and motion-blurs with speed, a speed-driven 'developing' light band on the after side, and 32px Before / After pills each clipped by the divider
